d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Customer Service Associate plays a key role in delivering exceptional service to customers. Responsibilities include maintaining store standards, managing inventory, and assisting with sales. The role involves handling customer inquiries and complaints, ensuring the store is well-stocked and visually appealing, and operating the cash register in accordance with company policies. Success in this role is measured by customer satisfaction, sales performance, and the organization and cleanliness of the store.
q: What Qualifies You For The Role
Previous experience in customer-facing roles, especially in retail environments, focused on excellent service.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with customers.
Ability to recommend products and actively engage in upselling and cross-selling.
Experience in operating cash registers and following cash handling procedures.
Ability to maintain high store standards, both in product organization and cleanliness.
Proven ability to work well within a team to achieve store goals.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
r: Engage with customers to provide a high level of service and assist with their needs.
Address basic customer complaints and escalate issues as needed.
Ensure that the store is well-organized and adheres to company visual merchandising standards.
Regularly clean and maintain the sales floor to create an inviting shopping environment.
Actively participate in receiving new shipments and restocking the store.
Help manage inventory and ensure the store is fully stocked.
Recommend products to customers based on their needs, focusing on upselling and cross-selling.
Stay updated on product information to make informed recommendations.
Operate the cash register, process transactions, and follow company policies for handling payments.
Ensure accurate cash handling and maintain a clean and organized checkout area.

d: The client is a Dubai-based real estate and hospitality developer building technology-enabled, design-led communities. It brings AI, smart-living systems and longevity-focused design into its residential and hospitality developments. Its engineering and agentic Smart Home/IoT teams are building intelligent environments that shape how AI is deployed in the physical world. It is now building a strong IT and infrastructure foundation to support that growth.

The client is seeking a hands-on, highly versatile IT Manager & Infrastructure Lead to own, manage and scale its complete hybrid IT, server and vendor ecosystem. You will bridge technical operations and vendor management, overseeing RFPs, Statements of Work (SOWs), software licensing and hardware procurement (including AI edge servers and lab gear), while directly maintaining cloud and local infrastructure.

You will manage the core IT foundation supporting the engineering and agentic Smart Home/IoT development teams. From AWS account provisioning and Linux server administration to Proxmox virtualisation, NAS backup management, on-premises lab hardware and live Smart Home installations (servers, hubs and switches running ZigBee, KNX, Matter over Thread and similar protocols), you will keep systems resilient, secure and performant.
q: Experience: 5+ years in System Administration, DevOps or IT Infrastructure Management.
Linux Expertise: Expert-level mastery of Linux system administration, performance tuning, security hardening and scripting (Bash, Python).
Cloud & Virtualisation: Strong experience managing AWS cloud infrastructure and hypervisor environments such as Proxmox VE.
Containers & Storage: Hands-on experience with Docker, container networking and enterprise storage systems (NAS, ZFS, RAID configurations).
Vendor & Budgeting: Direct experience managing vendor relationships, evaluating RFPs/SOWs, tracking licences and executing hardware procurement.
Networking & Hardware: Solid understanding of LAN/WAN, VPNs, VLANs and firewalls, and hands-on hardware troubleshooting.

Smart Home Systems: Proven experience installing, managing and maintaining Smart Home installations (servers, hubs, switches and controllers) using protocols such as ZigBee, KNX and Matter over Thread.
Tailscale & Remote Access: Working knowledge of Tailscale for managing virtual VPNs/mesh networks across sites, servers and devices.
Cameras & Sensors: Experience configuring and managing IP camera systems, and deploying sensors such as mmWave radar, presence and Bluetooth/BLE devices.
Electronics & Hardware Assembly: Good hands-on electrical knowledge (soldering, wiring, low-voltage power, reading schematics) for assembling ad-hoc ESP32-based devices.
Installation Vendor Coordination: Experience working with installers and contractors to deliver on-site hardware installations, from design review through commissioning.
Monitoring & Telemetry: Hands-on experience setting up monitoring, alerting and telemetry for networked devices and IoT/Smart Home systems.
Experience procuring and configuring AI/ML hardware (e.g., GPU servers, workstation setups, edge AI nodes).
Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
Experience with Smart Home platforms such as Home Assistant, and with ETS for KNX programming.
Relevant certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), CISSP or KNX Partner certification.
r: Lead the drafting, technical review and management of RFPs and SOWs from software, hardware and service vendors.
Review and optimise software licences, SaaS subscriptions and developer tooling across the organisation.
Manage procurement pipelines for high-performance compute hardware, GPU setups, edge platforms (NVIDIA Jetson, ESP32, Raspberry Pi) and lab equipment.
Monitor vendor SLAs, negotiate contract terms, and track IT budget allocations and spending.
Manage and provision AWS resources (IAM, VPCs, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, Cost Explorer) following security and cost-optimisation best practices.
Serve as the principal Linux Administrator (Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL) for all on-premises, edge and cloud server instances.
Build, deploy and manage containerised applications and local development environments using Docker and container registries.
Virtualisation, Storage, Backups & Local Hardware Lab
Administer, maintain and expand local virtualisation clusters using Proxmox VE (or ESXi) for staging, CI/CD runners and test environments.
Manage NAS/SAN storage architectures (e.g., TrueNAS, Synology) to ensure high-speed data availability, multi-tier automated backups and disaster recovery execution.
Maintain local hardware lab infrastructure, including managed network switches, VLANs, routers, firewalls, power redundancy (UPS) and IoT hardware test benches.
Install, manage and maintain Smart Home installations, including home servers, controllers, hubs, gateways, sensors and smart switches/actuators.
Configure and support devices across Smart Home protocols such as ZigBee, KNX, Matter over Thread, Z-Wave and Wi-Fi/IP-based devices, including Thread border routers and KNX IP interfaces.
Work with installation vendors and electrical contractors to plan, schedule and oversee hardware installations, reviewing their designs and SOWs and signing off on commissioning and handover.

Design and manage the local network infrastructure supporting the Smart Home systems: VLAN segmentation for IoT devices, Wi-Fi coverage, PoE, firewall rules, and secure remote access via Tailscale (tailnets, ACLs, subnet routers and exit nodes).
Configure and manage camera systems (IP/PoE cameras, NVRs, RTSP/ONVIF streams), including placement, recording and retention policies, and secure access.
Deploy, calibrate and maintain sensors, including mmWave radar and presence/occupancy sensors, Bluetooth/BLE beacons and proxies, and motion, contact and environmental sensors.

Build and assemble ad-hoc ESP32-based devices (soldering, wiring sensors and relays, power supply design and enclosure fitting), and flash and maintain their firmware (e.g., ESPHome, Arduino/ESP-IDF).

Oversee monitoring and telemetry from installed systems (device health, uptime, alerting, logs and metrics, e.g., MQTT, Prometheus, Grafana), and drive troubleshooting, firmware updates and preventive maintenance.
x: Competitive Tax-Free Salary: A market-leading monthly package in AED, commensurate with experience.
Performance Incentives: Rewards linked to delivery and performance outcomes.
Visa & Medical Insurance: Full UAE visa sponsorship and comprehensive health cover.
Paid Leave: 30 days’ annual leave plus UAE public holidays.
Annual Flight Ticket & End-of-Service Gratuity: As per UAE market practice and labour law.
Top-Tier Tooling: Modern hardware, a fully equipped lab and cloud tools.
Learning & Career Growth: Certification and conference support, with a clear path to leadership.
Autonomy & Impact: Build the IT and infrastructure function from the ground up and shape how AI is deployed in the physical world.

d: TK Elevator Almoayyed W.L.L.Location: Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain

TK Elevator Almoayyed W.L.L. is a leading provider of vertical transportation solutions in Bahrain, delivering innovative elevators, escalators, and mobility systems for residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects. We are committed to safety, quality, customer satisfaction, and engineering excellence.

The NI Sales Engineer is responsible for promoting and selling TK Elevator's New Installation solutions by combining technical engineering expertise with commercial acumen. The role involves supporting consultants, contractors, developers, and end users through the entire sales cycle, from project identification and traffic analysis to proposal submission and contract award.

The successful candidate must be capable of applying sound engineering principles in accordance with Bahrain Engineering Council requirements while ensuring compliance with local regulations, safety standards, and TK Elevator policies.
Conduct traffic analysis and recommend suitable elevator and escalator solutions.
Review project specifications, drawings, and tender documents.
Provide technical consultations to architects, consultants, contractors, and developers.
Coordinate with factories and engineering departments regarding technical requirements and product configurations.
Ensure proposed solutions comply with applicable safety codes, engineering standards, and project specifications.
Support value engineering initiatives to optimize project costs while maintaining performance and quality standards.
Identify new business opportunities within Bahrain's construction and real estate sectors.
Develop and maintain relationships with consultants, contractors, developers, and key decision-makers.
Prepare commercial and technical proposals, quotations, and tender submissions.
Negotiate contract terms and support the sales process through project award.
Maintain sales forecasts, project pipelines, and CRM records.
Represent TK Elevator at client meetings, exhibitions, and industry events.
Coordinate with Installation, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and QHSE departments.
Monitor project progress from award through handover.
Address technical queries and support customers throughout the project lifecycle.
Ensure smooth communication between clients and internal stakeholders.
Adhere to all TK Elevator QHSE policies and procedures.
Support implementation of ISO and quality management requirements.
Promote safe working practices and report any safety concerns.
Ensure compliance with Bahrain Engineering Council regulations and professional engineering standards.
Maintain professional integrity in all engineering recommendations and customer interactions.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Degree must be recognized by the relevant Bahrain authorities and suitable for Bahrain Engineering Council registration.
Registration with the The Council for Regulating the Practice of Engineering Professions - CRPEP or eligibility for registration is mandatory.
2 to 5 years of experience in sales engineering, elevators, building services, MEP, construction, or related technical industries.
Experience in vertical transportation solutions is highly preferred.
Knowledge of elevator and escalator systems.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
Understanding of traffic analysis and building transportation requirements.
Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
Arabic language skills are an advantage.
Why Join TK Elevator Almoayyed W.L.L.?
Work with a global leader in vertical transportation.
Exposure to landmark projects across Bahrain.
Career growth opportunities within the TK Elevator Group.

Bahraini or Expat Mechanical or Electrical Engineer registered with the Bahrain Engineering Council CRPEP (The Council for Regulating the Practice of Engineering Professions ), possessing strong communication skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to support clients and consultants with technically compliant elevator solutions while contributing to TK Elevator Bahrain's growth and objectives.

d: The Senior Legal Counsel – Bridge Holding provides expert legal support across the full private equity investment lifecycle, from deal origination and structuring through execution, portfolio management and exit. Reporting to the Senior Legal Director, the role leads the legal workstreams of acquisitions, minority and majority investments, co-investments and divestments, and advises on the governance and corporate affairs of Bridge Holding, its investment vehicles and portfolio companies. Working closely with the investment team, finance and external counsel, the Senior Legal Counsel protects the firm’s interests, manages legal risk and ensures that every transaction is executed efficiently, on sound terms and in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
q: 6 to 9 years of post-qualification experience in corporate and M&A work, gained in a leading law firm, a private equity firm, a sovereign or family investment office, or an investment holding company.
Qualified lawyer admitted to practise in a recognised common-law or civil-law jurisdiction; a licence or eligibility to practise in Qatar is an advantage.
Proven record of advising on and executing private equity, M&A and investment transactions from term sheet to completion, including cross-border transactions.
Strong drafting and negotiation skills in share purchase agreements, shareholders’ agreements, subscription and investment agreements, and related transaction documents.
Hands-on experience leading legal due diligence and converting findings into practical contractual protections and deal recommendations.
Sound understanding of investment structuring, holding and special purpose vehicles, minority investor protections, exit mechanisms and transaction financing.
Working knowledge of corporate governance, company secretarial practice and regulatory approvals, including merger control and foreign-ownership requirements.
Familiarity with Qatari commercial and companies law and GCC regulatory frameworks; experience with Qatar Financial Centre structures is an advantage.
Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to investment professionals and support sound investment decisions.
High integrity, discretion and resilience, with the ability to work under tight deadlines and manage several live transactions at the same time.

Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) or equivalent is required; an LLM in corporate, commercial or financial law is preferred. Excellent written and spoken English is essential; Arabic is a strong advantage.
r: Lead the legal execution of private equity transactions, including acquisitions, minority and majority investments, co-investments, bolt-on acquisitions, restructurings and exits.

Draft, review and negotiate key transaction documents, including term sheets, share purchase agreements, shareholders’ agreements, subscription agreements, investment agreements and disclosure letters.
Coordinate legal due diligence on target companies, review findings with the investment team and translate identified risks into price adjustments, warranties, indemnities and conditions precedent.
Structure investments and holding arrangements, including special purpose vehicles, holding companies and co-investment structures, in coordination with tax, finance and external advisers.

Secure appropriate investor protections in portfolio companies, including board representation, reserved matters, information rights, pre-emption, drag-along, tag-along, exit and anti-dilution provisions.
Manage the closing process for transactions, including conditions precedent, regulatory and merger-control approvals, completion deliverables, funds flow and post-completion obligations.
Prepare the legal sections of investment committee papers and advise the investment team on key legal risks, deal terms and negotiation positions.

Advise on the corporate governance of Bridge Holding, its investment vehicles and portfolio companies, including board and shareholder resolutions, constitutional documents and delegations of authority.
Oversee company secretarial matters across the investment structure, including incorporations, commercial registration filings, statutory registers, powers of attorney and corporate housekeeping.
Monitor portfolio companies’ compliance with shareholder agreements and investment terms, and support them on material corporate transactions, refinancings and governance matters.
Support acquisition and portfolio financing, including facility agreements, security packages, guarantees and lender requirements, in coordination with Finance.
Prepare for and execute exits, including vendor due diligence, sale processes, trade sales, secondary sales and other exit routes.

Advise on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to private equity investing, including foreign ownership, merger control, anti-bribery and corruption, sanctions, anti-money laundering and know-your-customer requirements.
Select, instruct and manage external law firms on transactions and disputes, ensuring quality of advice, value for money and effective control of legal fees.
Manage disputes arising from investments, including warranty and indemnity claims, shareholder disagreements and contractual disputes, in coordination with external counsel.
Maintain transaction precedents, standard templates, legal checklists and a central record of investment documents, obligations and key deadlines across the portfolio.
